meals.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta

day_of_steps: Pour 250 ml plain kefir into a blender.
Diego: add 100 g blueberries; Diana: add 80 g blueberries. Blend 30 seconds until smooth. Pour into glasses.
Toast sourdough slices: Diego 2 slices (80 g), Diana 1 slice (40 g).

Crack Diego's 2 eggs and Diana's 2 eggs into the pan (fry in batches if needed). Cook 2–3 min until whites are set, yolks still soft.
Plate eggs on sourdough. Crumble feta on top: Diego 30 g, Diana 20 g.
Serve with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water alongside.

prep_steps: Sunday: Cook 300 g dried green lentils (lentilles vertes) in salted water 20 min; drain and cool. Store in airtight container (good 5 days).
Sunday: Cook 400 g dry quinoa in salted water 15 min; drain, fluff, cool. Store in airtight container (good 3 days).
